name: dalux-build
title: Dalux Build
description: Search files, tasks and users in Dalux Build projects, and open project files.
author: bruadam

commands.name: search-files
commands.title: Search Files
commands.subtitle: Dalux Build
commands.description: Search a project's files across all file areas by name, number or folder, then open them.

commands.name: open-file
commands.title: Open File
commands.subtitle: Dalux Build
commands.description: Browse a project's file areas and folders and open a file with its default app.

commands.name: version-set-files
commands.title: Version Set Files
commands.subtitle: Dalux Build
commands.description: Pick a version set and open its files.

commands.name: search-tasks
commands.title: Search Tasks
commands.subtitle: Dalux Build
commands.description: Search a project's tasks by number, subject, type, status, responsible and comments.

commands.name: user-tasks
commands.title: User Tasks
commands.subtitle: Dalux Build
commands.description: Pick a user and see the tasks they are responsible for or created.

commands.name: work-package-tasks
commands.title: Work Package Tasks
commands.subtitle: Dalux Build
commands.description: Pick a work package and see its tasks.

commands.name: search-users
commands.title: Search Users
commands.subtitle: Dalux Build
commands.description: Search project users by name or email; copy or send an email.

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: API Base URL
preferences.description: The Dalux Build API base URL from Dalux, e.g. https://node1.field.dalux.com/service/api

preferences.name: defaultProject
preferences.title: Default Project
preferences.description: Optional project name, number or ID to start with until you pick a project.

preferences.name: preferredFileArea
preferences.title: Preferred File Area
preferences.description: Optional file area name or ID. File commands then show only that file area's files and version sets. Projects without it show all file areas.
